title: Near-miss notice misses a first-command test in a multi-line script when ; or && or a heredoc ends that first segment
outcome: In a script of several lines, which is never a check, a recognised test in the first command gets the typed uncredited near-miss line whatever ends that command (`;`, `&&`, a line break or a heredoc's `<<`). Even-run continuation is tested for cmd `^` and PowerShell backticks too.
acceptance: Near-miss notice misses a first-command test in a multi-line script when ; or && or a heredoc ends that first segment is done
